package fixture

// Calibration fixture for the writer residual scan: writeNote reaches a write
// verb and its file has no registry line; readNote only reads and must not
// count as a writer.

import "os"

func writeNote(path string, body []byte) error {
	return os.WriteFile(path, body, 0o644)
}

func readNote(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	return os.ReadFile(path)
}

func openForRead(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	return os.OpenFile(path, os.O_RDONLY, 0)
}
